proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the exact RDIM quadratic-risk representation, reduced its entries to one- and two-marked isolated-set coefficients, and closed an exact polynomial-time forest oracle together with standard SDP and Monte Carlo consequences. The field-bearing step collapsed because the bounded-treewidth join retained an XP-size multivariate message, while the alternative hardness branch never acquired a source problem, gadget, coefficient identity, or treewidth-preserving reduction. Future work should reuse the forest derivation and exact-risk setup, but must independently solve that separator frontier and must not reuse the underspecified Renegar algebraic-output claim without a precise source or a narrower theorem.
tldr: Weighted random isolation makes full-neighborhood treatment and control observable on a random independent set, but its restricted difference in means has random denominators and can be biased for the finite-population total effect. The core reduction writes this error as a \(2n\)-coordinate linear form and shows that every exact risk entry is determined by one- and two-marked isolated-count polynomials. The tier-bearing question is whether those polynomials admit an output-sensitive fixed-parameter algorithm in conflict-graph treewidth, yielding an explicit-runtime certified minimax mixture, or whether a required marked coefficient is parameterized-hard. A complete exact forest oracle supplies the positive base case. Exact rational matrices feed a standard finite-library ellipsoidal SDP consequence, while independent offline simulations give an operator-norm certificate on arbitrary graphs.
gap: AWRI selects priority weights using an MSE surrogate, randomized graph clustering resorts to exposure-probability resampling on unrestricted graphs, and order-counting theory warns that bounded treewidth does not automatically make priority integration fixed-parameter tractable. The closest unrestricted design-and-estimator minimax analysis leaves its maximal-independent-set functional implicit and does not compute the prespecified WRI/RDIM marked reciprocal-count risk.
fill: The project derives the exact marked-moment reduction, establishes rational output and a complete forest base case, and asks for either fixed-parameter separator compression or parameter-preserving hardness. On the positive branch, standard semidefinite optimization converts the exact oracle into an exactly certified WRI mixture with a stated runtime; arbitrary graphs retain a simulation fallback.
